report.summary: 4 confirmed/narrowed findings: handoff schema too strict, ledger.close() may hide errors, live_egress_seats might duplicate logic, spectral truncation could cause index errors. Proposed steps to inspect and fix.
risks: Changing ledger.close() could break existing cleanup if exceptions are expected to be suppressed.
Fixing spectral truncation may reveal downstream bugs that depend on the truncated length.
todos: Inspect ledger.py close() method; add logging if needed.
Inspect session.py live_egress_seats; refactor to delegate to available_providers.
Check topology.py consumers for eigenvalue length assumptions.
Update REPORT_SCHEMA or handoff field type to allow structured data.

items.title: Inspect ledger.py close() method for silent exception swallowing
items.why_now: Potential silent masking of sqlite3 errors during connection close could hide corruption or resource leaks.

steps.do: Inspect the close() method in daedalus/spine/ledger.py for exception handling; add logging if necessary.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'def close' daedalus/spine/ledger.py; review the try/except block.

items.assumption: The close() method exists in ledger.py as per the index.

items.title: Verify live_egress_seats delegates to available_providers
items.why_now: Risk of inconsistency if live_egress_seats duplicates provider availability logic.

steps.do: Open daedalus/council/session.py and inspect live_egress_seats implementation; if it duplicates logic, refactor to call available_providers or provider_health.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'live_egress_seats' daedalus/council/session.py; check if it calls 'available_providers' or 'provider_health'.

items.assumption: live_egress_seats is defined in session.py as indicated by the cited_source.

items.title: Fix spectral truncation mismatch in topology.py
items.why_now: If component_count > 8, eigenvalues list is truncated, potentially causing index errors downstream.

steps.do: In daedalus/structcore/topology.py, change min(component_count, 8) to component_count to avoid truncation, or document that downstream must handle shorter list.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'min(component_count, 8)' daedalus/structcore/topology.py; check that the fix is applied.

items.assumption: The truncation is in topology.py as per the narrowed finding.

items.title: Update REPORT_SCHEMA to allow structured handoff data
items.why_now: Current schema with additionalProperties: false prevents any structured data beyond a single notes string, breaking potential consumers.

steps.do: Modify REPORT_SCHEMA in daedalus/eval/report.py to allow additional properties or change handoff field type to object.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'REPORT_SCHEMA' daedalus/eval/report.py; check that additionalProperties is not false or handoff type is updated.

items.depends_on: Inspect ledger.py close() method for silent exception swallowing
items.assumption: REPORT_SCHEMA is defined in report.py as per the finding.
